newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY TO SELL 12-18 PCT OF MOL STAKE IN 97.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY TO SELL 12-18 PCT OF MOL STAKE IN 97.

text.p: Hungary plans to sell 12 to 18 percent of its remaining stake in oil and gas company MOL Rt during 1997, privatisation minister Judit Csiha said on Friday.
"Our major project will be Mol," Csiha said at an economic forum in Budapest.
Csiha, who is the minister in charge of the state privatisation agency APV Rt, said the government was hoping to realise 28 to 40 billion forints from the sale.
MOL, which is the biggest Hungarian company in terms of capitalisation, was partially privatised in 1995 when some 19 percent was sold to private investors.
